description: Permanently delete one item (question or stimulus) from a New Quiz (LTI) by its item_id. This is irreversible — there is no undo and no tool to restore a deleted item. Returns { success: true }; Canvas does not hand back the deleted item. Find item_id with list_new_quiz_items or get_new_quiz_item. Use delete_new_quiz instead to remove the whole quiz, or update_new_quiz_item if you only need to change the item rather than remove it. assignment_id identifies the New Quiz (from list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment), not a Classic Quiz ID. Requires permission to manage quizzes in the course.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz

item_id.description: The New Quiz item ID (string, not numeric)

name: delete_new_quiz_item
title: Delete New Quiz Item
